_comment: BindingGYM's official experimental configuration applied to H3-DDG, with exactly two exceptions retained from H3-DDG: the thermodynamic-cycle readout and zero backbone noise. Everything else -- optimiser, schedule, loss, batching, epoch structure, early stopping and the selection set -- is BindingGYM's. Rationale (user, 2026-08-25): H3-DDG's Appendix A.4 describes its SKEMPI v2 experiments, so it is not the right source for a BindingGYM run.
_comment_from_bindinggym: Paper A.3.2 + training/{main.py,run.sh,dataset.py,loss.py}. AdamW lr 1e-3 / weight_decay 0.05 / eps 1e-5 / betas (0.9,0.99) with OneCycleLR; ListMLE; 100 epochs; patience 3; 256 optimiser steps per epoch (their __len__ of batch_size*256); same-assay batches drawn with assays sampled uniformly; batch_size 8 from run.sh.
_comment_batch_size: BindingGYM's value. It will very likely not fit: measured on the 1016-residue 4D5_HER2 structure, H3-DDG's O(K^2) triplet attention needs ~11 GiB per slate item, so 8 would want ~88 GiB. The startup probe halves until it fits and logs the result, so the run records what it actually used rather than silently diverging.
_comment_select: Unused while early_stop is false -- nothing is scored between the scheduled checkpoints, so no selection subset is built at all.
_comment_kept_from_h3ddg: Two deliberate exceptions. (1) The readout stays H3-DDG's thermodynamic cycle (Eq 16) rather than BindingGYM's mask-all-mutations-and-difference-logit-sums; the cycle is the model. (2) backbone_noise stays 0.0 rather than BindingGYM's augment_eps 0.2.
_comment_architecture: H3-DDG's architecture, unchanged and identical field for field to config/train_h3-ddg.json.
_comment_no_early_stop: User decision 2026-08-25: H3-DDG is far more expensive per evaluation than BindingGYM's plain ProteinMPNN, so BindingGYM's every-epoch selection would cost ~1h x 50 epochs on f1. Instead: no stopping rule, train a fixed 50 epochs, and score the FULL held-out fold at epochs 10/20/30/40/50, keeping all five checkpoints. Five evaluations instead of fifty, and the result is a trajectory rather than one selected point. This is a deliberate, recorded departure from BindingGYM's patience-3 rule; every other field is still theirs.
_comment_patience: Dropped: no early stopping, so BindingGYM's patience 3 does not apply.
